heroLead: Idagdag ang suporta sa wikang Uzbek sa Wuthering Waves at gawing mas accessible ang Solaris-3 para sa mga manlalarong nagsasalita ng Uzbek.
whyText1: Wuthering Waves connects players across cultures, countries and languages. We believe Uzbek-speaking players should have the opportunity to experience the world of Solaris-3 in their own language.
whyText2: This project is a community effort to show Kuro Games that there is real, measurable interest in Uzbek language support.
card1Text: A large and growing global Uzbek-speaking community deserves stronger representation in games they love.
card2Text: The request is powered by real players who want to spend more time in Solaris-3.
card3Text: Anyone around the world can stand with Uzbek Rovers and help amplify the request.
card4Text: More language support means more players can feel at home while exploring the game.

messageP1: Wuthering Waves has brought together players from many different cultures and languages around the world.
messageP2: We respectfully ask Kuro Games to consider adding Uzbek language support to Wuthering Waves. This campaign represents players who would love to experience Solaris-3 in Uzbek, alongside supporters from around the world who want to help make this possible.
messageP3: Thank you for listening to your community.
faq1Q: Why are you requesting Uzbek language support?
faq1A: Because Uzbek-speaking players want a more accessible way to experience Wuthering Waves and the wider community wants to show that demand clearly.
faq2A: Wala. Libre ang pagsali sa kampanya.
faq3Q: Maaari bang sumuporta ang mga manlalaro sa labas ng Uzbekistan?
faq4A: Hindi. Ito ay kampanyang pinangunahan ng komunidad at hindi kaanib ng Kuro Games.
faq5A: No. Email addresses remain private and are not shown on the public supporter list.
aboutText: This project is a community-led initiative created by Wuthering Waves players who would like to see Uzbek language support added to the game.
